atoms.b: Individual and ((society)) as well as identity and ((belonging)) are not mutually exclusive. Rather, they can be ((complementary)). If someone's ((identity)) is accepted by society, they feel like they belong.
Likewise, ((conformity)) and individualism are considered opposite ends of a ((spectrum)), rather than a binary ((choice)).

atoms.text: Elias learned to trust the sound of his own voice, to form his own opinion away from the masses and to do what he deems right, no matter what others might say. His actions now reflect the pursuit of personal goals and values over collective expectations. Still, he feels like he belongs.
